ero.name: markdovido
ero.description: A Markdown view: shows a source in Markdown (CommonMark and pipe tables) with the Eroj of the system — headings, paragraphs, emphasis, code, quotes, lists to depth three, tables, rules and links — built from text alone, so nothing of the source runs.

props.name: source
props.description: The Markdown, as text. No HTML passes: what looks like HTML is shown as text; a link takes https:, http:, mailto: or a relative target, and opens with rel noopener noreferrer; an image is shown by its text.

props.name: start-level
props.description: The level of a heading # in the page: one below the page's own h1 by default, so the headings of the source keep the order of the page (Regulo heading-levels-in-order).
